text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I won, Tama... I... actually won!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah. I refused to lose. I ran 
with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I managed to live up to Tama's 
expectations too...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Stop talkin' like I'm already dead and 
gone!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, seriously?!! I'm sooooo 
frustrated!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I could've taken one more step! I could've 
run! I know I had it in me!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still... you were stronger this time. 
It's... my loss.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it ain't over yet! Right after 
this comes the final showdown—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We've got the Arima Kinen. Right~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Creek...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ngaah! Creek, stop stealin' my lines!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry~. I just got a little too excited♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Both of your runs were so incredible! You 
both worked so hard♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"There you go again, trying to spoil us 
like that—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Tama-chan. When it comes 
to competition, I won't go easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because I finally get to race Oguri-chan 
again. And this time Tama-chan is here 
too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I was looking forward to it, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm not going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm the one who's gonna win! I'll 
chew you all up and prove beyond a shadow 
of a doubt that I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Let's take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will keep on winning. Because there is 
someone waiting for me... waiting for the 
strong me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to Tama, nor Creek. The one 
who will take the Arima Kinen... is me.

—Gathering an array of exceptional 
talents, this year's Arima Kinen will 
truly be a clash at the summit.

Still, Oguri Cap can win this. I'll give 
her my full support with what time 
remains!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Or rather, Creek, where did you even 
get in from?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Through the entrance, of course.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's any other route, 
but... Is there something else?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant at allーーー!!
